title: ClaimProvenance
description: Canonical schema for claim-level evidence provenance in literature research

claim.description: Specific factual proposition or finding asserted

source.description: Short bibliographic citation or paper identifier

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the source if available, or null

location.description: Specific location of evidence within the source document

section.description: Section or subsection name/number, or null if unlocated

table.description: Table or figure identifier, or null if not in a table

page.description: Publication page number or range, or null if unlocated

support.description: Degree of material support provided by the inspected source

confidence.description: Confidence level in source identity, location, and attribution
